# **Blind SSRF with out-of-band detection**

Task: This site uses analytics software which fetches the URL specified in the Referer header when a product page is loaded.

To solve the lab, use this functionality to cause an HTTP request to the public Burp Collaborator server.

Toolkit:BurpSuitePro, Browser

1. just view product and send req with your domain in refer
